g.title: invariants
g.text: Preserve OX-108 event mapping, source-time/carry meaning,
celestial paths, image transforms, existing precipitation,
timeline/forecast UI, and all non-Urban-Park themes.

g.title: transparency
g.text: Each cloud type is painted separately and has its own sky track.
Rates differ from Sun/Moon paths; numeric rates are unspecified.
Every layer has alpha 0 outside its active cloud forms.
